name: Turf Live
summary: A live hockey scorecard: players move on a drawn pitch, goals slam in and the timeline updates itself
about: A live match card for a hockey final with a blue pitch drawn in SVG, where twelve players shift with the ball as it is passed around. Every match minute can bring a shot, a save, a penalty corner or a card; a goal ripples the net, flashes the card in the team's colour, slams GOAL in over the scoreboard and rolls the score. The timeline, stats and momentum chart update as it plays, and at full time the winner gets confetti before the match replays.
how: Watch the match play: one match minute passes every second, with breaks between quarters.
Switch between Timeline, Stats and Predict with the tabs (arrow keys work too).
Turn on Goal alerts to get a ringing bell and a toast for every goal.
In Predict, pick who scores next: a right pick is worth 50 points.
Press Pause to freeze the match and Resume to carry on; after full time, replay from the start.
